premises.text: People often miss opportunities to connect with others at events like conferences.
premises.evidence_span: you've come to an amazing conference like TechCrunch Disrupt, full of brilliant and beautiful people, only to stand by the conference bar eating peanuts, wondering who you should talk to next.

premises.text: Sonar can uncover hidden connections between people at events.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar is a mobile application that uncovers the hidden connections that you share with everyone else in this room.

premises.text: Sonar aggregates publicly available profile data to show connections.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar scours the web for people at this venue, then aggregates and synthesizes publicly available profile data.

premises.text: Sonar allows users to send hyper-targeted messages to people they want to meet.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar sent a personal, hyper-targeted message to someone in this room with enough social proof to get the conversation started.

premises.text: Sonar aims to democratize in-person connections.
premises.evidence_span: our goal is to democratize the meat space.

premises.text: Sonar provides a medium for local self-expression at events.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar is laser-focused on giving you a way to tell people here that you're here and this is what you're about.

value.text: Sonar helps people make meaningful connections at events.
value.evidence_span: to make that connection, to get that story, to get that deal.
